ko.executive_summary: SteamOS now runs natively on Apple Silicon Macs with significantly improved gaming performance, achieving Windows game frame rates up to 2.9x higher in testing.
key_facts: SteamOS runs on Apple Silicon Macs
Windows game frame rates up to 2.9x higher in tests

implications.text: SteamOS expansion to Apple Silicon enables broader gaming platform compatibility and improves developer targeting options.
Frame rate improvements suggest effective CPU/GPU utilization on ARM-based Apple hardware compared to native Windows execution.
